column3: Upon the Registration of the Demutualized Stock
every  company  listed  on  the  Colombo  Stock
Exchange, limited by guarantee shall be deemed to
be  a  company,  listed  on  the  Demutualized  Stock
every subsidiary company of  the Colombo Stock
Exchange  shall  be  deemed  to  be  a  subsidiary
company of the Demutualized Stock Exchange.
